ITEM 1 | Shredded potato pieces, golden-brown with darker crispy edges and some browned flecks, loose strands forming a mound on the left side of the plate, moderately dry surface with slight sheen, about 12 cm across and 2 cm tall, covering roughly 25% of the plate | 130
ITEM 2 | Scrambled eggs, bright yellow with pale creamy patches, soft clumped curds with a moist, slightly glossy look, irregular heap about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, sitting beside the shredded potato on the lower left of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Brussels sprouts, halved and cooked, bright green with darker charred or browned edges, glossy and moist, clustered in a dome about 9 cm across and 3 cm tall, placed between the potato and the sausages in the upper right | 120
ITEM 4 | Smoked sausage links, reddish-brown with a slightly glossy, firm casing, cut into rounds about 3 cm in diameter and 2 cm thick, some with a pale pink interior visible at cut faces, arranged in a cluster on the right side of the plate | 150
ITEM 5 | Sausage slices, reddish-brown, firm, cut diagonally into pieces about 4 cm long and 2 cm thick, one piece with a pale pink cut face, lying at the lower right edge of the plate | 60
